note: The tokens the beta trades on Robinhood Chain mainnet (specs/003-mainnet-beta/contracts/token-registry.md). Reviewed like code. CHIT's pool is the launchpad's, the one the buyback buys through (deployments/buyback-4663.json); its hook takes 2% on every swap, which the local quote does not see, so its bound is 3%: the hook's 2% and 1% of price movement. The checks are re-run on a fork by test/fork/token-registry-4663.test.ts and re-recorded here on the day the beta opens (T075). Up to three memes may join, named by the founder first (T062); tokenized equities sit here disabled until legal clears them.
